mathematicaly:<br>
AI Model: $s_t \rightarrow a_t$

environment: $(s_t,a_t) \rightarrow s_{t+1}$ <br>
 Where:

$(s_t)$: current sensor state<br>
$(a_t)$: Robot action<br>
$(s_{t+1})$: New sensor state

For example:
[0.80,0.25,1.00]→[−0.65,0.20]→[0.60,0.35,1.10]<br>
The robot has turned left, so the next sensor measurements are different.
